hackTheSystem:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Computes the number of swap movements needed to reduce the total damage of the S and C virus code to at most the shield value, returning IMPOSSIBLE when the number of S instructions exceeds the shield." hackTheSystem]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> softwareToHack </REF>: String[] "Two-element array: softwareToHack[0] is the shield value parsed as a long, and softwareToHack[1] is the virus code string composed of 'S' and 'C' characters."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: String "The resulting movement count as a decimal string, '0' if no movements are needed, or the string 'IMPOSSIBLE' when the number of S instructions exceeds the shield."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize shootDamage to 1, shootCounter to 0, damage to 0, and movements to 0; parse softwareToHack[0] as a long into shield; set code to softwareToHack[1]; set sizeScript to code.length() - 1; set lastIterableElement to sizeScript. RESULT state_initialized]
            [COMMAND Scan code from index 0 to code.length() - 1 inclusive with i++; if code.charAt(i) == 'S', add shootDamage to damage and increment shootCounter; if code.charAt(i) == 'C', double shootDamage. RESULT initial_damage_and_shoot_count_computed]
            [COMMAND Check whether damage is less than or equal to shield; if true, return String.valueOf(movements) immediately. RESULT initial_damage_le_shield_check]
            [COMMAND Check whether shootCounter is greater than shield; if true, return the string 'IMPOSSIBLE' immediately. RESULT impossible_condition_check]
            [COMMAND Start the nested rearrangement loops: outer loop for i = sizeScript while i >= 0, with the normal update i-- running after the inner loop completes; inner loop for j = sizeScript - 1 while j >= 0, with the normal update j-- running after each inner body. In each iteration, first test if code.charAt(j) == 'S' and code.charAt(i) == 'S'; if true, decrement i and continue to the next j. RESULT ss_branch_checked]
            [COMMAND Within the same nested loops, if the first test was false and code.charAt(i) == 'C', halve shootDamage using integer division, decrement i, decrement lastIterableElement, and continue to the next j. RESULT c_at_i_branch_applied]
            [COMMAND Within the same nested loops, if the previous tests were false and code.charAt(j) == 'C' and code.charAt(i) == 'S', increment movements, subtract shootDamage / 2 from damage using integer division, convert code to a char array, and if damage <= shield return String.valueOf(movements) immediately; otherwise swap the characters at positions j and i, update code from the char array, and then if i == lastIterableElement, halve shootDamage and decrement i when i > 0; otherwise increment i and add 2 to j. RESULT swap_branch_applied]
            [COMMAND After the nested loops finish, return String.valueOf(movements). RESULT final_movements_returned]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: After computing initial damage, damage is less than or equal to shield.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return String.valueOf(movements), which is currently '0'. RESULT early_return_movements]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: After computing initial damage, shootCounter is greater than shield.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return the string 'IMPOSSIBLE'. RESULT impossible_return]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: During a swap branch, after subtracting shootDamage / 2 from damage and before swapping, damage is less than or equal to shield.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return String.valueOf(movements) immediately without completing the swap. RESULT mid_swap_success_return]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
